cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm putting our holiday things in order. I've kept twelve tickets. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are in the album I made you. Don't pull it apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The album stays whole. I'll find it a box; apparently I'm keeping both our memories safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a box for it. It's under the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the album in, then. I'll write the dates on the lid. You won't even have to open it to remember our trips.

reason: Final dialogue/variety correction: B supplied box becomes a labeled memory aid through A claimed superior remembering; remove stairs, back-risk and the duplicate physical-sacrifice ending.
